blocks.title: Sasha Stiles: A LIVING POEM | MoMA, Made with p5.js
blocks.description: Exhibition. Sep 10, 2025–Mar 3, 2026. What does it mean to be human in the age of artificial intelligence? Since 2018, artist and poet Sasha Stiles has explored this question through collaborations with her alter ego, Technelegy, an evolving AI system trained to emulate and augment her writing and voice. Their projects consider how human and machine minds process language, shaping new forms of expression for a rapidly changing world. Made with p5.js.

Gemini 2.5 Demo Made with p5.js: Create a JavaScript animation of complex flocking behavior
blocks.description: From Google DeepMind: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental is also our most advanced coding model yet. See it in action as it creates an interactive p5js demo of colorful boids inside a spinning hexagon. Prompt: p5js (no HTML) swarm of 30 colorful boids swimming inside a rotating hexagon. I like supernova nebulae.

blocks.title: Gemini 2.5 Demo Made with p5.js: Create your own dinosaur game from a single line prompt
blocks.description: From Google DeepMind: See how Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental uses its reasoning capabilities to create a game, using executable code from a single line prompt. What will Gemini create if you change 'dinosaur' to something else? Prompt: Make me a captivating endless runner game. Key instructions on the screen. p5js scene, no HTML.

blocks.title: Gemini 2.5 Demo Made with p5.js: Make your own interactive demo
blocks.description: From Google DeepMind: See how Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental uses its reasoning capabilities to create an interactive p5js demo of cosmic fish with a simple prompt. What will Gemini create if you change 'fish' and 'nebulae' to something else? Prompt: Create a beautiful, interactive p5js demo (no HTML). I like fish and nebulae.

blocks.title: Gemini 2.5 Demo Made with p5.js: Code a visualization of a Mandelbrot set
blocks.description: From Google DeepMind: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental unlocks state-of-the-art performance in coding, math and science, and multimodal reasoning. See how it creates a p5js simulation of intricate fractal patterns to explore a Mandelbrot set. Prompt: p5js to explore a Mandelbrot set.

blocks.title: Jeff Dean, former Chief Scientist at Google, demo Gemini 2.5 with p5.js.
blocks.description:
> @JeffDean - [https://x.com/JeffDean/status/1904580112248693039](https://x.com/JeffDean/status/1904580112248693039)

Gemini 2.5 Pro is unlocking really exciting use cases at the intersection of coding and math.

I remember my excitement when I first learned about the Mandelbrot set as a kid.  Check out the code the Gemini 2.5 Pro model wrote given the prompt “p5js to explore a Mandelbrot set”!
